column1: bbVan preparation - This includes removing the bulkhead, taking out any pre-existing furniture, or cleaning the van, ready to be converted.
Drivers side sliding window & passenger side fixed window
Plywood and heavy duty vinyl flooring
Slatted wooden ceiling with LED strip lights
A compact but functional kitchen, with an oak worktop, a 50L fridge/freezer, and a range of induction hob and sink options
A u-shape seating area that folds out into a large bed, big enough for two. With plenty of storage, and even a designated area to have your own portable toilet.
Cushions with your choice of fabric
A charging system to keep you batteries charged up, whether that is utilising your vans alternator via DC-DC charging, solar panels, shore power via a hook-up point, or all of the above
An electrical system to suit your needs, including 12V charging points, ceiling lights, reading lights and 240V plug sockets.
